description: Ragi crop wilting, soil dry since the last spell; farmers report poor tillering.
Maize leaves curling in the afternoon, no borewell water left.
Groundnut sown late, germination patchy because of dry spell.
Yellowing of lower leaves in ragi; farmer suspects nitrogen deficiency.
Standing water in paddy fields for three days after heavy rain; seedlings submerged.
Sugarcane field waterlogged, root rot starting in the low-lying patch.
Blast-like lesions on paddy leaves after continuous wet weather.
Brown planthopper hoppers seen in large numbers at the base of paddy plants.
Paddy crop showing hopper burn patches; two farmers affected in the same block.
Cotton pink bollworm larvae found in green bolls.
Stem borer damage, dead hearts visible in about a tenth of the field.
Canal release delayed; maize needs one protective irrigation.
Community tank level low, only one irrigation possible this month.
Farmer reports pale ragi crop; no affected-area measurement given.
Leaf folder damage observed along the field bund.
Ragi growth uneven; farmer did not specify the area affected.
